scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && npm run build:dev-proxy -w apps/chrome-extension && npm run dev:proxy
scripts.build:shared: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/ui
scripts.build:chrome: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w apps/chrome-extension
scripts.build:mac: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w apps/macdesktop
scripts.build:windows: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w apps/windowsdesktop
